reading: There are growing tensions between the United States and Iran.
US President Donald Trump recently spoke about the situation.
He vowed to take strong action against Iran.
He said the US would strike next week if no agreement is reached.
The planned strikes would target Iran's important bridges.
They would also target the country's power plants.
This action depends on if Iran does not return to talks.
Iran has also threatened to block important trade routes.
Blocking trade routes could stop many ships from moving.
This situation is serious for global stability and trade.

vocabulary.definition: feelings of anger or disagreement between people or countries.
promised very strongly to do something.
to attack something or someone, often with military force.
structures built over water or roads to allow people and vehicles to cross.
formal discussions between groups or countries to solve problems.
To state an intention to stop something, often by preventing access or movement, like closing a passage.

entries.ja: 人々や国の間に生じる怒りや意見の相違の感情。
entries.ko: 사람이나 국가 사이에 생기는 분노나 의견 차이의 감정.
entries.zh-Hans: 人们或国家之间产生的愤怒或分歧的情绪。
entries.es: Sentimientos de enojo o desacuerdo entre personas o países.
entries.pt-BR: Sentimentos de raiva ou desacordo entre pessoas ou países.

entries.ja: 何かをすることを非常に強く約束した。
entries.zh-Hans: 做出非常坚定的承诺去做某事。

entries.ja: 何かや誰かを攻撃すること、しばしば軍事力を用いて。
entries.ko: 무언가나 누군가를 공격하는 것, 흔히 군사력을 사용하여.
entries.zh-Hans: 攻击某物或某人，通常使用军事力量。
entries.es: Atacar algo o a alguien, a menudo con fuerza militar.
entries.pt-BR: Atacar algo ou alguém, frequentemente com força militar.

entries.ja: 人や乗り物が渡れるように、水面や道路の上に建てられた構造物。
entries.ko: 사람이나 차량이 건널 수 있도록 물이나 도로 위에 건설된 구조물.
entries.zh-Hans: 建在水面或道路上方，供人们和车辆通行的结构。
entries.es: Estructuras construidas sobre agua o carreteras para permitir el paso de personas y vehículos.
entries.pt-BR: Estruturas construídas sobre a água ou estradas para permitir a passagem de pessoas e veículos.

entries.ja: 問題を解決するために、集団や国の間で行われる公式な話し合い。
entries.ko: 문제를 해결하기 위해 단체나 국가들 사이에 이루어지는 공식적인 논의.
entries.zh-Hans: 团体或国家之间为解决问题而进行的正式讨论。
entries.es: Discusiones formales entre grupos o países para resolver problemas.
entries.pt-BR: Discussões formais entre grupos ou países para resolver problemas.

entries.ja: 何かを阻止する意図を表明すること。しばしば、通行や移動を妨げることで、例えば通路を閉鎖するような行為。
entries.ko: 어떤 통로나 움직임을 막는 등 접근이나 이동을 방해하여 어떤 것을 멈추겠다는 의도를 표명하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 声明阻止某事的意图，通常是通过阻止通行或移动，例如关闭通道。
entries.es: Declarar la intención de detener algo, a menudo impidiendo el acceso o el movimiento, como cerrar un paso.
entries.pt-BR: Declarar a intenção de impedir algo, frequentemente bloqueando o acesso ou o movimento, como fechar uma passagem.
